notes.title: Our new game + developer community links
notes.content:
Hello! It's been some time since we've given an update here and that's poor form on our end ːsteamsadː But we're back now! And with two bits of news.

1- If you're interesting in chatting it up with us, we've now got a Discord. We've got some new stuff cooking and we'll be sharing news, WIP art and videos, etc in our newly formed [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]. We'll also be doing the occasional game giveaway and such there. If a newsletter or Twitter is more your thing, we're got those too. So if you're interesting in learning more about our previous games (we have 10!) and being the first to get info and opportunities to playtetst our next one (we're actively working on it!), plus game giveaways, we'd love for you to join our community. Here are the links:
[list]
[*] [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]
[*] [url=robotinvader.com/newsletter/ ]Robot Invader Newsletter[/url] (promise, no spam!)
[*] [url=https://x.com/robotinvader]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

2- our latest game SEEING THINGS recently launched! Woohoo!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=DS_communityupdate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12663215/e74d964983935be9cf5a6368a433a8c28792c4f1.png[/img][/url]

It's been a lot of fun seeing players and streamers alike enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=DS_communityupdate]SEEING THINGS[/url]. It's currently sitting at 100% positive reviews. And if it sounds like it's your thing --it's got the perfect blend of silly and spooky -- we'd love for you to check it out too!

notes.title: Stop a 70s serial killer in Dead Secret Circle
notes.content:
This week, Robot Invader released the sequel to Dead Secret, which was one of the first VR horror-mystery titles I ever got to experience. I enjoyed that game’s puzzles and general otherworldy vibe — not to mention its Kansas based setting. (That’s where I’m from. There’s a lot of murders there. It felt good to solve one.) Dead Secret Circle builds on the successes of its predecessor by expanding the lore of the universe, but also leaning-in hard on a more stylized, bizarro look, where everything has neon outlines and the unspeakable evils seem more… unspeakabler.

(more…)

notes.title: Vive Update Live!
notes.content:
Dead Secret is now available on HTC Vive! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12663215/024b5084528e0646324056fe06976da5f0d9d8dc.png[/img]

To celebrate the occasion, Dead Secret is 34% off--US $9.89--for two weeks. Oh yeah!

A few notes:
[list]
 [*]for those who have already purchased Dead Secret, Vive support will arrive via an update today at no additional cost
 [*]both the Vive Wands and gamepads are supported. To switch to the Wand, simply click the trackpad. You only need one Wand to play
 [*]both standing and seated play are supported
 [*]select the VR mode by launching Dead Secret while SteamVR is running, or by right-clicking and selecting "Launch Vive Version."  Your save data is shared between VR- and non-VR versions.
 [*] Oculus Rift owners can access their free version of Dead Secret via our Oculus Key Validation Tool. 
[/list]

Thank you for the support and reception to date. We're excited to hear your thoughts and feedback on solving a murder in VR. It's a grisly business, but we hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Dead Secret coming to Vive - August 18th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12663215/e6cc8f36eea8af85ba630f977f7c67287efd53c2.jpg[/img]

We have been excited about bringing Dead Secret to the Vive for some time now and are happy to announce that come [b]Thursday, August 18th[/b], you can dive into the bizarre case of Harris Bullard's death in beautiful VR on HTC Vive. 

[b]Vive Release Date[/b]
August 18th, 2016

[b]Price[/b]
It will remain at $14.99. For those that already own Dead Secret, the Vive version will be made available at no additional cost

[b]Controller[/b]
Vive Wand and gamepad will both be supported

It has been great to see this community's positive response to Dead Secret to-date and we eager to get the VR version in your hands to see how you like it. Solving a compelling murder is an engaging experience for sleuth enthusiasts and we look forward to hearing your feedback and reactions about doing that in immersive VR. Enjoy!

notes.title: Oculus Key Redemption Tool is Online!
notes.content:
If you own Dead Secret you can now unlock your free Oculus copy by heading over to this page and signing in:

[url=http://robotinvader.com/deadsecret/steam/]Dead Secret Oculus Key Redemption[/url]
